prov.text: The allowance for credit losses remained strong at 1.34 percent of total loans, providing 508.9 percent coverage of nonperforming loans—a substantial increase from 345.4 percent in 3Q25 and consistent with 470.3 percent in the linked quarter, reflecting a conservative approach to risk management. Annualized net loan charge-offs to average loans remained exceptionally modest at less than 1 basis point, improving from 6 basis points in the linked quarter and comparable to less than 1 basis point in the prior year quarter, with net charge-offs totaling $17,000.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Income and Noninterest Expense
nonint.text:
Total noninterest income for the third quarter of 2026 was $4.7 million, up 9.6 percent from the $4.2 million reported in the third quarter of 2025. The year-over-year expansion was driven primarily by higher net mortgage banking revenue, supported by increased loan servicing fees of $946,000 and a positive OMSR valuation recapture, alongside steady, consistent contributions from our Wealth Management and Title Insurance divisions. “The resilience of our fee based revenue stream validates our diversified business model, as cross-functional referral strategies continue to anchor our above median level of growth,” Klein noted.

Noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 increased 14.4 percent to $13.2 million from $11.5 million in the prior-year quarter, driven by an increase of $1.14 million in salaries and employee benefits, which totaled $7.3 million, reflecting higher incentive costs and medical expenses. Data processing fees for the quarter stood at $1.12 million compared to $723,000 in the prior-year quarter, while marketing expenses increased to $358,000 from $174,000 in 3Q25. Both of these categories reflect higher costs related to several pending client and product conversions. These increases were partially offset by disciplined reductions in other expenses, which declined $95,000, and employee expenses, which decreased $41,000 from the prior-year period.

net.text: “Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was stable at $3.9 million, a 2.5 percent decrease from the prior-year quarter, with GAAP DEPS of $0.63, a decrease of 1.6 percent,” said Mark A. Klein, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer. While our bottom-line results were slightly lower compared to the prior year, this marks our 63rd consecutive quarter of profitability. Our performance this quarter reflects the continued resilience of our core community banking operations—highlighted by our tenth consecutive quarter of loan growth—and dynamic contributions from our fee-based business lines, which helped mitigate the impact of elevated operating expenses and broader economic pressures.

net sales.text: Total operating revenue for the third quarter of 2026 was $18.1 million, an increase of 9.0 percent year-over-year and slightly improved from the linked quarter. This revenue growth was primarily driven by steady gains in our loan portfolio and resilience in noninterest income categories. Net interest income was $13.4 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase from $12.3 million in the third quarter of 2025 and $13.0 million in the second quarter of 2026. Total interest income rose to $20.5 million, propelled by robust loan volume and repricing dynamics. Total interest expense was $7.1 million, a 9.7 percent increase from the prior-year period as deposit costs adjusted to the current rate environment. As a result, net interest margin was 3.50 percent, expanding 2 basis points from the third quarter of 2025.

intro.text: Headquartered in Defiance, Ohio, SB Financial is a diversified financial services holding company for the State Bank & Trust Company (State Bank) and SBFG Title, LLC dba Peak Title (Peak Title). State Bank provides a full range of financial services for consumers and small businesses, including wealth management, private client services, mortgage banking and commercial and agricultural lending, operating through a total of 27 offices: 25 in eleven Ohio counties and two in Northeast, Indiana, and 27 ATMs. State Bank has four Residential loan production offices located throughout Ohio and Indiana. Peak Title provides title insurance and title opinions throughout the Tri-State and Kentucky. SB Financial’s common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Capital Market with the ticker symbol “SBFG”.

lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
